newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Deutsche Telecom unit seeks $1 bln credit line.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telecom unit seeks $1 bln credit line.

text.p: Isla Communications Co (Islacom), a Philippine affiliate of Deutsche Telekom, said on Monday it is negotiating for a $1 billion credit line with Chase Manhattan Corp and Westdeutsche Landesbank (WestLB).

Islacom vice-president Mario Fernandez told reporters the credit facility would help bankroll the company's $2 billion investment plan for its fixed line installations, mobile phone and paging operations.
Islacom, which operates a cellular phone system and an international gateway facility (IGF), is mandated to install a total of 700,000 telephone lines.
By the end of the year, Islacom expects to install 450,000 of those lines.
The company said it also expects to increase its paging subscriber base from 18,000 to 60,000 this year.
Thailand's Shinawatra Computer and Communications Plc is part owner of Islacom.
